extraction.Name: Rudolph D. Anderson
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded August 19, 1920, by E. O. Frescoin
extraction.Buyer: Rudolph Anderson and others mortgaged this land and some other land to Eugene N. Smith for $15,000 subject to the $10,000 mortgage; then on January 22, 1921, Rudolph B. Anderson and others conveyed this other land to Aetna Life Insurance Co. for $10,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739668 issued; Southeast quarter section 2, township 97, north of range 75; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 3, 1920; document appears incomplete/truncated
